description.value: Chilliwack MCC Thrift Shop is a nonprofit secondhand store operated by Mennonite Central Committee, a Mennonite and Brethren in Christ relief organization active since 1920. The shop sells donated clothing, housewares, books, media, sports equipment, and collectibles, with proceeds supporting international aid and development programs. Touring cyclists may find affordable gear, used books, or odds and ends at this community-oriented shop on Kipp Ave.
